result.note: Tested the new partnership level and the visit's concrete outcomes (first visit, defence LoI, ICCR AI Chair).

questions.prompt: In June 2026, during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's state visit to Slovakia, India–Slovakia bilateral ties were elevated to which level?
questions.explain: The visit raised ties to a Comprehensive Partnership and produced eleven agreements. Slovakia also reaffirmed support for India's permanent UNSC seat and its bid to join the Nuclear Suppliers Group.
questions.source: Modi became the first Indian Prime Minister to visit Slovakia since the country's independence in 1993, using the trip to elevate bilateral ties to a Comprehensive Partnership.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Slovakia in June 2026:
items: He became the first Indian Prime Minister to visit Slovakia since its independence in 1993.
Defence cooperation between the two countries was formalised through a Memorandum of Understanding.
India will set up its first ICCR Chair in Artificial Intelligence at the Technical University of Kosice.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong. Defence was covered by a Letter of Intent, while the MoUs dealt with labour migration, digital technologies, higher education, audio-visual creation and quantum communication. The leaders also set up a Joint Working Group on Counter-Terrorism and a Consular Dialogue.
questions.source: India will set up its first Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) Chair in Artificial Intelligence at the Technical University of Kosice.
